review_method: Actually viewed v2 raw, actual1x multi-background and4x nearest-neighbor; compared v1, original identity and four core references.

visual.identity: Recognizable near-fifty man: neatly swept gray hair, pointed trimmed beard, narrow projecting nose, deliberate small eyes, mature lower cheek, firm closed mouth. Dark brown coat and muted plum inner collar retained.
improvements: Hair now a few much broader gray-brown locks instead of fine silver ribbons.
Eye apertures and sclera reduced/darkened substantially; face reads closer to references.
Neck substantially shortened, collar compressed to narrow bottom strip.
Under-eye/cheek and nose broad planes support around-fifty age.
residuals: Some thin beard divisions and neutral gray eye highlights persist.
Underlying generated raster still contains fine antialiasing; 74x100 is a technical reduction.
Raw meaningful right margin about9–12px, therefore selected inset only creates a safer export margin; it is not new anatomy.
visual.source_containment: At alpha >=5 the complete generated silhouette is inside raw frame with no meaningful edge contact. Crown and visible ear intact.
